notes:
Transcript: see the words under the waveform and click to jump. Made on this Mac with Apple speech recognition; nothing is uploaded.
Lower gaps: turn down hiss and room noise in the pauses between phrases by 3, 6 or 10 dB.
Low-cut and de-ess on just the selected section, faded in so they never click.
Repair: remove DC offset and flip a channel wired out of phase, also as one-click fixes under Source checks.
Snap: section edges and in/out points land on the quietest nearby moment so edits never cut a word.
Versions: save alternative edits of a cue and switch between them.
